answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing jobs whose outputs are checked against hidden test cases and by staking a bond in a vault that is slashed when audits find fraud. A prism-style assignment sends related tasks to independently sampled agents, while a mesa aggregates only answers that agree within a tolerance; colluding identities therefore risk exposing one another. Creating extra accounts does not multiply influence without more accepted work and bonded capital, so a sybil attacker pays in compute, time, and slashable stake.
